description.narrative: The purpose of Integrated Service Delivery Activity (ISDA) is to accelerate reductions in maternal, newborn, and child morbidity and mortality by partnering with the Government of Rwanda (GOR) to strengthen the capacity of host-country institutions and local organizations to improve equitable access and utilization of high-quality, evidence-based, and respectful public health services. Focus areas are maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health (MNCAH); family planning (FP) and reproductive health (RH); and malaria. Given the environment of emerging pandemic threats, the ISDA will contribute towards strengthening national capacity to detect, prepare and respond to health emergencies.
